game.title: The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings Enhanced Edition
game.blurb: Story-driven fantasy role-playing game in which the witcher Geralt of Rivia clears his name, from CD PROJEKT RED, released 2012-04-16. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genre: RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings", "The Witcher 2" or the full Enhanced Edition title. witcher.fandom.com has "The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings" (used as fandomTitle), with about 129 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema gives only the placeholder name "ValveTestApp20920". 14 of 52 Steam achievements are hidden. "Oh My God! You Killed the Kayran! You Bastards!" was put in the kayran chapter because its name says so; the other 13 sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder, and several (for example "Kingmaker", "Summer Solstice" and "Winter Solstice") are probably tied to particular quests or choices rather than the main line. "Man of the Shadows" mentions both Loredo's garden and the kayran trap and was put in the kayran chapter. RAWG lists a playtime of only 7 hours, which looks low.
